about_the_game:
Step into the line of duty in this tactical first-person shooter where every second counts. You are a police officer tasked with restoring order in unpredictable, high-risk scenarios. In this police FPS, every mission is a test of your judgment. Whether you're breaching buildings, clearing out hostile suspects, or navigating through hostage situations, one thing is certain - every choice you make matters.

Neutralize armed threats, secure and free innocent civilians, and collect and report critical evidence to complete missions. Explore two demo environments designed to simulate real-world environments. Every mission is unique, pushing you to adapt, stay alert, and coordinate your strategy.

Do you have what it takes to bring order to the chaos?

content_descriptors.notes: Contains frequent violence and scenes of realistic gun combat. Players will encounter blood effects, armed suspects, and deceased characters as part of core gameplay. While the visuals are stylized, the themes may not be suitable for all audiences.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Quad-core) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 / AMD Radeon Pro 450 / Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: May require lower settings for smooth performance
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (6-core) or Apple M2/M3
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 560 / Apple M2 GPU (or better)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs best at high settings with smooth frame rates
